features.name: text_length
features.description: Total character length of raw post text

features.name: word_count
features.description: Number of whitespace-delimited tokens in post text

features.name: sentence_count
features.description: Number of sentences derived by sentence boundary punctuation

features.name: uppercase_ratio
features.description: Proportion of uppercase alphabet characters to total alphabetic characters

features.name: digit_ratio
features.description: Proportion of numeric digit characters to total length

features.name: punctuation_ratio
features.description: Proportion of punctuation characters to total length

features.name: url_count_in_text
features.description: Count of embedded URLs and http/https hyperlinks in text

features.name: phone_count
features.description: Count of observable phone numbers or country dial codes (+91)

features.name: email_count
features.description: Count of email addresses formatted with @ and valid domains

features.name: currency_symbol_count
features.description: Count of currency symbols (₹, $, Rs, INR, USD)

features.name: exclamation_count
features.description: Count of exclamation marks (!) in post text

features.name: question_count
features.description: Count of question marks (?) in post text

features.name: language
features.description: Primary linguistic code (en, ta, hi, ta-en, hi-en)

features.name: language_id
features.description: Integer mapping of primary language

features.name: script
features.description: Primary writing script (Latin, Tamil, Devanagari)

features.name: is_code_mixed
features.description: Flag indicating multilingual code-mixing (e.g., Hinglish, Tanglish)

features.name: is_transliterated
features.description: Flag indicating transliterated text into Latin script

features.name: language_confidence
features.description: Confidence score of language identification

features.name: claim_count
features.description: Total count of claims extracted from post

features.name: atomic_claim_count
features.description: Total count of atomic claim predicates

features.name: verifiable_claim_count
features.description: Count of extracted claims marked verifiable

features.name: non_verifiable_claim_count
features.description: Count of extracted claims marked unverifiable or opinion

features.name: claim_decomposition_confidence
features.description: Mean check-worthiness / decomposition confidence across claims

features.name: has_financial_claim
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one FINANCIAL claim

features.name: has_job_claim
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one JOB / employment claim

features.name: has_giveaway_claim
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one GIVEAWAY / lottery claim

features.name: has_credential_claim
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one CREDENTIAL solicitation claim

features.name: has_shopping_claim
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one SHOPPING e-commerce claim

features.name: conditional_claim_count
features.description: Count of claims containing conditional clauses or prerequisite commitments

features.name: negated_claim_count
features.description: Count of claims containing explicit negation operators

features.name: numeric_claim_count
features.description: Count of claims specifying numerical return percentages or amounts

features.name: temporal_claim_count
features.description: Count of claims specifying time periods (daily, weekly, monthly)

features.name: evidence_count
features.description: Total count of grounded evidence items retrieved for claims

features.name: has_evidence
features.description: Flag indicating if post has at least one grounded evidence item

features.name: claims_with_evidence
features.description: Count of claims supported by at least one evidence item

features.name: claims_without_evidence
features.description: Count of claims having zero retrieved evidence

features.name: evidence_coverage_ratio
features.description: Proportion of claims that have grounded evidence items

features.name: evidence_source_count
features.description: Count of distinct evidence sources cited

features.name: independent_source_count
features.description: Count of distinct domains among evidence source URLs

features.name: source_diversity
features.description: Ratio of independent sources to total evidence items

features.name: retrieved_evidence_count
features.description: Total count of retrieved candidates in retrieval pool

features.name: relevant_evidence_count
features.description: Count of relevant evidence items in retrieval pool

features.name: supporting_retrieval_count
features.description: Count of supporting evidence retrieved

features.name: contradicting_retrieval_count
features.description: Count of contradicting evidence retrieved

features.name: top_retrieval_score
features.description: Candidate similarity score or -1.0 if dense scores unassigned

features.name: retrieval_score_available
features.description: Flag indicating if dense retrieval score is populated

features.name: support_count
features.description: Count of evidence items with relation SUPPORTS

features.name: contradict_count
features.description: Count of evidence items with relation CONTRADICTS

features.name: neutral_count
features.description: Count of evidence items with relation NEUTRAL

features.name: insufficient_count
features.description: Count of evidence items with relation INSUFFICIENT

features.name: support_ratio
features.description: Ratio of SUPPORTS evidence to total evidence items

features.name: contradiction_ratio
features.description: Ratio of CONTRADICTS evidence to total evidence items

features.name: neutral_ratio
features.description: Ratio of NEUTRAL evidence to total evidence items

features.name: insufficient_ratio
features.description: Ratio of INSUFFICIENT evidence to total evidence items

features.name: support_to_contradiction_ratio
features.description: Ratio of support_count to (contradict_count + 1)

features.name: contradiction_presence
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one CONTRADICTS evidence item

features.name: support_presence
features.description: Flag indicating presence of at least one SUPPORTS evidence item

features.name: evidence_relation_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy over 4 relation classes (SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, NEUTRAL, INSUFFICIENT)

features.name: image_count
features.description: Number of attached media images

features.name: has_image
features.description: Flag indicating presence of image attachments

features.name: ocr_available
features.description: Flag indicating whether OCR text was successfully extracted

features.name: ocr_confidence
features.description: Mean OCR engine confidence or -1.0 if unavailable

features.name: ocr_text_length
features.description: Character length of extracted OCR text

features.name: image_reuse_count
features.description: Count of previous cluster reuse matches for image hash

features.name: phash_match_count
features.description: Count of perceptual hash matches across image registry

features.name: ocr_unreliable
features.description: Flag indicating OCR text available but confidence is below 0.50

features.name: source_count
features.description: Count of cited evidence sources

features.name: unique_source_count
features.description: Count of unique source IDs cited in evidence

features.name: official_source_present
features.description: Flag indicating citation of official regulatory source

features.name: domain_count
features.description: Count of distinct domains referenced in post or evidence URLs

features.name: unique_domain_count
features.description: Count of unique internet domains

features.name: official_domain_match
features.description: Flag indicating evidence URL matches official government/regulatory domain

features.name: domain_age_days
features.description: Domain registration age in days or -1.0 if unqueried/missing

features.name: domain_age_available
features.description: Flag indicating if domain age is legitimately available

features.name: shortened_url_count
features.description: Count of shortened URLs (bit.ly, tinyurl, t.me) in post text

features.description: Total nodes in post's heterogeneous evidence graph

features.name: graph_evidence_nodes
features.description: Count of EVIDENCE nodes in heterogeneous graph

features.name: graph_url_nodes

features.name: graph_account_nodes
features.description: Count of ACCOUNT nodes in heterogeneous graph

features.name: graph_insufficient_edges
features.description: Count of INSUFFICIENT_FOR directed edges in graph

features.description: Observable advance fee, registration deposit, or processing fee request

features.name: financial_claim_count
features.description: Count of claims specifically making financial assertions

features.description: Flag indicating presence of monetary amount or currency denomination
